text:
mira: Heading to a one-day conference that turns into a late-night social — any must-haves for an overnight carry-on? 

alex: +1 to a lightweight change of clothes, something wrinkle-resistant. pack one nicer top if there's a later dinner.

samir: comf shoes for daytime, foldable flats for evening (if you wear them). also travel toothbrush + tiny toothpaste.

kelly: travel towel? only if you're staying in a cheap hotel. otherwise hotel provides. also earplugs and eye mask = lifesavers. :zzz:

devon: pro tip: put backup socks/undies in a zip bag so you can swap them quickly. also tiny ziplock for sweaty shirt after late event.

mira: good call. what about charging? adapters? power banks?

alex: small 20k mAh power bank. carry a short USB-C cable and a wall brick with foldable prongs. i carry a 3-port USB-C + USB-A brick.

samir: if you want to share: bring a cheap multi-outlet strip (2-plug) — hotels sometimes have 1 outlet by the desk only.

kelly: add a 2m short belt or hair tie in the pocket. and a stain stick or small laundry soap sheet.

devon: outfit roll: top -> socks -> underwear -> chargers -> toiletries -> shoes on bottom. saves space.

mira: anyone bring a quick-first-aid/minor-med kit?

alex: small pouch: bandaids, ibuprofen, antacid, allergy pill. single-use hand sanitizer + disinfectant wipes.

samir: bring a reusable water bottle — saves $$$ and keeps you hydrated after late drinks.

kelly: If conference runs late, scope nearby 24h food or delivery options ahead of time. i once got stranded at 11:30pm with no dinner. :grimacing:

devon: i screenshot the hotel check-in instructions & any shuttle times and put them in photos for offline.

mira: any tips for overnight hygiene if you only have carry-on?

alex: face wipes, dry shampoo, deodorant, travel toothpaste, a tiny face mist. quick change into fresh shirt + socks = instant better.

samir: roll a small collapsible water cup + toothbrush = brush in hotel bathroom sink quick.

kelly: i keep a pair of washable slip-on shoes — easy in hotel room and comfy for late walks.

devon: packing checklist i use: 
- 1x outfit change
- toiletries pouch 
- small med kit 
- power bank + cable 
- phone charger + plug 
- socks/undies in zip bag 
- sleep mask/earplugs 
- emergency cash/card

mira: love this. do we want to meetup after the last session? anyone local?

alex: i'm flying in but free for drinks after 9pm. ping me @mira and i'll DM location suggestions. :beers:

samir: if it's near the venue, check parking/ride-share surge. might be cheaper to walk a few blocks.

ops-bot: Reminder: Always check hotel cancellation time and any late check-in notes. Hotel phone + booking ref saved to trip notes.

kelly: meme: "packing for an overnight conference like i'm moving countries" :joy:

mira: haha. ok i'm set. thanks y'all. appreciate the tiny life hacks :heart:

devon: safe travels! post pics of the swag haul pls. :camera:
